name: sidelong
description: Always-on-top overlay showing live Claude Code state, driven by Claude Code hooks.

scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @sidelong/protocol && npm run build -w @sidelong/agent-adapters
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w @sidelong/desktop
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @sidelong/desktop && npm run build -w sidelong-claude-status-bar
